head: codex/5602-hosted-coverage-no-report
title: [v0.91.8][CI] Prevent partition-local llvm-cov report crashes
body:
Closes #5602

Repairs the hosted authoritative coverage lane after PR #5599 run 29773292101 proved that all tests could pass while a redundant partition-local `llvm-cov report` crashed with SIGBUS. Every partitioned `cargo llvm-cov nextest` command now uses supported `--no-report` profile-collection mode; the existing explicit combined ADL and Runtime reports remain authoritative.

No test selector, partition, threshold, summary, or fail-closed gate is weakened. The focused typed PVF lane passed, the build/profile/output plan resolves under `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-5602-coverage`, and an exact-revision bounded review returned no findings. No AWS or raw gh was used.
